The '''Mercenary Guild of Coyn''' was the main [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization. It was hired out its services to all legal organizations seeking military forces for legal activities. The guild employed no less than 1% of the native population of [[Coyn]], generating a considerable portion of the planetary income. The Guild would hire out soldiers to serve legal government entities such as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but would not hire out soldiers to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. However, once the Alliance transitioned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Guild made it services available to the new galactic government. The guild had offices located in the [[Elrood Bazaar]], [[Torina]], [[Derilyn]], and [[Lanthrym]].
